environment.host_load_note: external CPU training may run concurrently; CPU/GPU latency is scoped to recorded host load, not isolated throughput

protocol.data: independent deterministic batch per optimizer update; paired across arms
protocol.hooks: separate diagnostic run; deduplicated backing-storage save lifetime, not resident VRAM; inner nonreentrant checkpoint hooks shadow outer hooks so checkpoint-interior saves are not fully observed
protocol.host_load: external CPU training may run concurrently; CPU/GPU latency is scoped to recorded host load, not isolated throughput
protocol.latency: phase seconds include explicit synchronization at each phase mark; segment arms keep detached chunk losses on device and convert once after the loop, so no per-chunk synchronization
protocol.loss: parity dense sum cross entropy divided by batch*length for every chunk
protocol.memory: CUDA phase live allocated/reserved and reset phase peak allocated/reserved; whole-update peaks reconstructed as max of phase peaks; separate process working set
protocol.oom: record OOM with unchanged batch/precision/length; no automatic retry; CUDA allocated/reserved and since-reset peaks sampled in the handler
protocol.process: one fresh subprocess per arm and length; no allocator sharing
protocol.purpose: R6 real optimizer update memory diagnostics
protocol.route_full: all recurrence and global encoder/projection paths attached
protocol.route_truncated: detach s/dk/dv each8; global e/mk/mv gradients retained
